# `cfmat.backtesting`

<!-- generated by tools/gen_api_docs.py; do not edit -->

Backtesting engines and reports (M11, M12). Costs live in ``cfmat.microstructure.costs``.

```text
vectorized     position x return backtests, grid search, walk-forward (signal functions)
event_driven   bar-by-bar engine with orders, broker and risk checks
rule_engine    trade-level engine for ``StrategySpec`` rules (stops, targets, trailing)
optimize       parallel sweeps, coarse-to-fine, walk-forward for ``StrategySpec``
report         trade statistics, monthly tables, comparisons and charts
```

### `cfmat.backtesting.event_driven`

Event-driven backtester (M11).

| Name | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `Context` | `class Context(symbol: str, broker: PaperBroker, history: pd.DataFrame = <factory>, _pending: list[Order] = <factory>) -> None` | What a strategy sees on each bar: its symbol, the broker, and the history so far. |
| `Context.order` | `order(self, qty: int) -> None` | Queue a market order: positive qty buys, negative sells. |
| `Context.order_target` | `order_target(self, target_qty: int) -> None` | Send the order that moves the position to ``target_qty``. |
| `run_event_backtest` | `def run_event_backtest(bars: pd.DataFrame, strategy: Strategy, cash: float = 1000000.0, symbol: str = 'SYN', slippage_bps: float = 2.0, cost_model: IndianCostModel \| None = None, segment: str = 'equity_delivery', risk: RiskManager \| None = None) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, PaperBroker]` | Replay OHLCV ``bars`` through ``strategy``. Returns (equity table, broker). |
| `SmaCrossStrategy` | `class SmaCrossStrategy(fast: int = 20, slow: int = 50, qty: int = 100) -> None` | Reference strategy: hold ``qty`` shares while the fast SMA is above the slow SMA. |
| `SmaCrossStrategy.on_bar` | `on_bar(self, ctx: Context, bar: pd.Series) -> None` | Hold ``qty`` shares while the fast SMA is above the slow SMA, otherwise flat. |
| `Strategy` | `class Strategy()` | Subclass and override ``on_bar``. |
| `Strategy.on_bar` | `on_bar(self, ctx: Context, bar: pd.Series) -> None` | Called at each bar's close with the history up to and including ``bar``. |
| `Strategy.on_start` | `on_start(self, ctx: Context) -> None` | Called once before the first bar. |

### `cfmat.backtesting.optimize`

Parameter search for Strategy Creator specs: parallel sweeps, coarse-to-fine search, walk-forward and strategy x instrument matrices (M12).

| Name | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `coarse_to_fine` | `def coarse_to_fine(bars: pd.DataFrame, spec: StrategySpec, grid: dict[str, list], top_k: int = 3, workers: int = 1, backend: str = 'process', rows: slice \| None = None, **backtest_kwargs) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, int]` | Smarter search: test every other value of each parameter first, then only the neighbours of the ``top_k`` coarse winners. Returns (results, evaluations). |
| `expand_grid` | `def expand_grid(grid: dict[str, list]) -> list[dict]` | Every combination of a parameter grid, as a list of dicts. |
| `strategy_matrix` | `def strategy_matrix(universe: dict[str, pd.DataFrame], specs: dict[str, StrategySpec], workers: int = 1, backend: str = 'process', **backtest_kwargs) -> pd.DataFrame` | Backtest every strategy on every instrument (long format: one row per pair). |
| `sweep` | `def sweep(bars: pd.DataFrame, spec: StrategySpec, grid: dict[str, list] \| list[dict], workers: int = 1, backend: str = 'process', rows: slice \| None = None, **backtest_kwargs) -> pd.DataFrame` | Backtest every parameter combination; results sorted by Sharpe. |
| `walk_forward` | `def walk_forward(bars: pd.DataFrame, spec: StrategySpec, grid: dict[str, list], train: int = 750, test: int = 250, workers: int = 1, backend: str = 'process', **backtest_kwargs) -> tuple[pd.Series, pd.DataFrame]` | Re-optimise on each training window, trade the next test window. |

### `cfmat.backtesting.report`

Backtest reports: trade statistics, summary tables and charts (M11, M12).

| Name | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `backtest_stats` | `def backtest_stats(result) -> pd.Series` | One-line report for a ``strategy_builder.BacktestResult``. |
| `compare` | `def compare(results: dict) -> pd.DataFrame` | Side-by-side stats for several backtest results. |
| `monthly_returns_table` | `def monthly_returns_table(returns: pd.Series) -> pd.DataFrame` | Compounded return (%) per calendar month, years as rows, plus a yearly total. |
| `plot_backtest` | `def plot_backtest(bars: pd.DataFrame, result, title: str = '')` | Price with entries/exits, equity curve and drawdown. Returns the figure. |
| `trade_stats` | `def trade_stats(trades: pd.DataFrame) -> dict[str, float]` | Win rate, payoff, expectancy and streaks from a trade list with a ``return`` column. |

### `cfmat.backtesting.rule_engine`

Bar-by-bar execution of a ``StrategySpec`` with trade-level accounting (M12).

| Name | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `backtest` | `def backtest(bars: pd.DataFrame, spec: StrategySpec, cost_bps: float = 5.0, slippage_bps: float = 2.0, size: float = 1.0, allow_reverse: bool = True) -> BacktestResult` | Run ``spec`` bar by bar. Returns daily returns (fraction of capital, with ``size`` × capital notional per position), positions and a trade list. |
| `BacktestResult` | `class BacktestResult(spec: StrategySpec, returns: pd.Series, position: pd.Series, trades: pd.DataFrame) -> None` | Outcome of a rule-engine backtest: daily returns, positions and the trade list. |
| `BacktestResult.stats` | `stats(self) -> pd.Series` | Summary statistics of the backtest (see ``cfmat.backtesting.report.backtest_stats``). |
| `signals` | `def signals(bars: pd.DataFrame, spec: StrategySpec) -> pd.DataFrame` | Evaluate the four rule lists (AND within each list) at every close. |

### `cfmat.backtesting.vectorized`

Vectorised backtesting and parameter search for signal functions (M11).

| Name | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `grid_search` | `def grid_search(close: pd.Series, strategy: Callable[..., pd.Series], grid: dict[str, list], cost_bps: float = 0.0) -> pd.DataFrame` | In-sample Sharpe for every parameter combination (the overfitting trap). |
| `pairs_backtest` | `def pairs_backtest(y: pd.Series, x: pd.Series, legs: pd.DataFrame, capital: float = 1000000.0, cost_bps: float = 0.0) -> pd.DataFrame` | Rupee P&L of a pair where ``legs`` holds unit positions from ``pairs_signals``. |
| `portfolio_backtest` | `def portfolio_backtest(prices: pd.DataFrame, weights: pd.DataFrame, cost_bps: float = 0.0) -> pd.DataFrame` | Backtest target weights across many instruments (weights decided at close). |
| `vectorized_backtest` | `def vectorized_backtest(close: pd.Series, signal: pd.Series, cost_bps: float = 0.0) -> pd.DataFrame` | Backtest a single-instrument target-position series. |
| `walk_forward` | `def walk_forward(close: pd.Series, strategy: Callable[..., pd.Series], grid: dict[str, list], train: int = 504, test: int = 126, cost_bps: float = 0.0) -> tuple[pd.Series, pd.DataFrame]` | Re-optimise on each training window and trade the next test window. |
